title: daucus maritimus
intro: Daucus maritimus, commonly known as sea carrot or sea hemlock, is a biennial plant species within the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Daucus maritimus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Daucus maritimus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
